title: Comparing the Effectiveness of Low-Carbon Policies: A Technology Diffusion Approach
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This paper studies the effectiveness of different policy instruments in accelerating the adoption of low-carbon technologies. Despite substantial declines in the costs of these technologies, diffusion remains uneven, driven by local economic conditions and policy environments. Using a modeling approach grounded in technology diffusion theory, the paper assesses how price-based (for example, carbon taxes and subsidies) and non-price-based (for example, mandates and regulatory requirements) instruments affect technology diffusion and carbon emissions across four East Asian economies. The analysis explicitly accounts for path dependence, learning, and technology uncertainty, factors often overlooked in standard models. The results highlight the importance of timing and policy sequencing: in the early stages of diffusion, price instruments may be less effective while non-price instruments can more successfully address coordination failures and subsequently enhance the impact of carbon pricing. The optimal policy combinations ultimately depend on the stage of technological maturity, initial technology adoption patterns, and local conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究不同政策工具在加速低碳技术采用方面的有效性。尽管这些技术的成本已大幅下降，但其扩散仍然不均衡，受到当地经济条件和政策环境的驱动。本文采用基于技术扩散理论的建模方法，评估基于价格的工具（例如碳税和补贴）以及非基于价格的工具（例如强制性要求和监管规定）如何影响四个东亚经济体的技术扩散和碳排放。分析明确考虑了路径依赖、学习效应和技术不确定性，这些因素在标准模型中常常被忽视。结果突出了时机和政策排序的重要性：在扩散的早期阶段，价格工具的效果可能较弱，而非价格工具则能更有效地解决协调失灵问题，并随后增强碳定价的效果。最优政策组合最终取决于技术成熟阶段、初始技术采用模式以及当地条件。

title: The Returns to Innovation in East Asia: The Role of the Business Environment and Firms' Characteristics
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: The paper studies the relationship between innovation efforts, innovation outputs, and productivity, using firm-level data from six East Asian countries. Firms are more likely to invest in innovation when they use technology licensed by a foreign company, are part of a large group, and have a more educated workforce. Investment in research and development can significantly boost both product and process innovation. Product innovation yields significant productivity gains. However, productivity gains from process innovation are not detectable in the sample.
abstract_zh: 本文利用六个东亚国家的企业层面数据，研究创新投入、创新产出与生产率之间的关系。当企业使用外国公司授权的技术、属于大型集团且拥有受教育程度较高的劳动力时，更有可能投资于创新。研发投资能够显著促进产品创新和工艺创新。产品创新带来显著的生产率提升。然而，在本样本中未能检测到工艺创新带来的生产率提升。

title: The impact of weather insurance on consumption, investment, and welfare
venue: Quantitative Economics
abstract: I develop and estimate a dynamic stochastic optimization model to assess the impact of weather insurance on the consumption, investment, and welfare of farmers in developing countries. Weather insurance has the potential to provide large welfare gains, equivalent to a permanent increase in consumption of almost 17%. Moreover, it can allow for the adoption of riskier but more productive seeds, further enhancing welfare. The interplay with other uninsured risks, the presence of liquidity constraints, basis risk, and loading factor on the insurance premium may account for the low take-up that is often empirically observed.
abstract_zh: 本文构建并估计了一个动态随机优化模型，用以评估天气保险对发展中国家农户消费、投资和福利的影响。天气保险有可能带来巨大的福利收益，相当于永久性地提高约17%的消费水平。此外，它还可以促使农户采用风险更高但生产率更高的种子，从而进一步提升福利。其他未投保风险的相互作用、流动性约束的存在、基差风险以及保险保费中的附加费率，可能解释了实证中经常观察到的低投保率。

title: Handling the weather: insurance, savings and credit in West Africa
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Farmers in developing countries face a wide array of risks. Yet they often lack formal financial instruments to protect against risks. This paper examines the impact on consumption, investment, and welfare of the separate provision of three financial products: weather insurance, savings, and credit. The paper develops a dynamic stochastic mode to capture the essential features of the lives of West African rural households. The model is calibrated with data from farmers in Burkina Faso and Senegal, to assess quantitatively the effects of three policy interventions. For each intervention the analysis first considers a benchmark scenario that abstracts from the flaws that affect each instrument; later the assumptions are relaxed. Weather insurance offers the largest welfare gains at each level of wealth, although the gains are significantly reduced by introducing a multiple on the insurance premium. Over time, however, savings can lead to substantial gains, higher than those achievable by unsubsidized weather insurance.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家的农户面临各种各样的风险，但他们往往缺乏正规的金融工具来防范这些风险。本文考察了分别提供三种金融产品——天气保险、储蓄和信贷——对消费、投资和福利的影响。本文构建了一个动态随机模型，以刻画西非农村家庭生活的基本特征。该模型以布基纳法索和塞内加尔农户的数据进行校准，以定量评估三项政策干预的效果。对于每一项干预，分析首先考虑一个剥离了各工具缺陷的基准情景，之后再放松这些假设。在每个财富水平上，天气保险都带来最大的福利收益，但若在保费上引入一个乘数，收益会显著减少。不过，从长期看，储蓄可以带来可观的收益，高于未补贴天气保险所能实现的收益。

title: Distortions in farmer prices since the 1950s: South Africa in international perspective
venue: Agrekon
abstract: The Simon Brand Memorial Lecture was delivered on 26 September 2007 at Johannesburg. For decades, earnings from farming in many low-income countries have been depressed by a pro-urban bias in own-country policies, as well as by governments of richer countries favoring their farmers with import barriers and subsidies. Both sets of policies reduce national and global economic growth. They also add to inequality and poverty in developing countries, since most of the world's billion poorest people depend on farming for their livelihood. Over the past two decades numerous developing country governments have reduced their sectoral and trade policy distortions, while some high-income countries also have begun reforming their protectionist policies. Drawing on results from a new multi-country research project, this paper examines the extent of South Africa's reforms relative to those of other temperate-zone Southern Hemisphere countries, of Northern Hemisphere rich countries, and of other developing countries. It concludes by pointing to the scope and prospects for further pro-poor policy reform at home and abroad.
abstract_zh: 本文为纪念西蒙·布兰德（Simon Brand）而设的讲座于2007年9月26日在约翰内斯堡举行。几十年来，许多低收入国家的农业收入一直受到本国政策中城市偏向的压制，同时富裕国家的政府又通过进口壁垒和补贴来扶持本国农民。这两类政策都会降低国家和全球的经济增长。它们还加剧了发展中国家的不平等和贫困，因为世界上最贫困的十亿人口中，大多数依靠农业维持生计。过去二十年间，众多发展中国家政府削减了部门和贸易政策扭曲，而一些高收入国家也开始改革其保护主义政策。本文借鉴一项新的多国研究项目的成果，考察南非的改革程度，并将其与其他温带南半球国家、北半球富裕国家以及其他发展中国家的改革进行比较。文章最后指出，国内外进一步推进有利于穷人的政策改革的空间和前景。
